items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: And I had one uncle on my mother's side. He played guitar, which was Eugene. Oh. That's my middle name.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about your parents? Have they played music? Your father or any brothers or any one?

Well, my grandfather, he played guitar. All my uncles, aunts on my father's side. My father, he played guitar. Played guitar. And I had one uncle on my mother's side. He played guitar, which was Eugene. Oh. That's my middle name. Maybe after he was a guitar player.
